title: SQL AG scale-out: remove + MANUAL-seed re-add a replica
description: The nexus-cli scale-out verbs for the Always On AG: REMOVE a secondary replica, then re-add it via MANUAL seeding (backup -> SFTP-ferry -> RESTORE WITH MOVE NORECOVERY -> SET HADR). This is also the named recovery command for a drifted/NOT_HEALTHY secondary.

observe.what: sql-ag-rep-2 removed from the AG; the primary + the other secondary keep serving
sql-ag-rep-2 re-added via manual seeding -> CONNECTED + SYNCHRONIZING (automatic seeding fails here: the FCI files live on the shared S:\\ which has no path on a local-C:\\ replica)

whatProves: AG replicas scale out/in via manual seeding (path-agnostic, required because the FCI primary is on shared storage); scale-out add doubles as the zero-touch recovery for a failed secondary.
